heading: From intent to merged code in three steps
description: Helix turns a natural-language goal into a chain of small, verified, reviewable units of work.

steps.title: Describe the goal
steps.description: Tell Helix what you want in plain language. No prompts to engineer — just the outcome.
bullets: Optional constraints: stack, files to touch, tests required
Helix reads your repo to ground the request

steps.title: Decompose & orchestrate
steps.description: Helix breaks the goal into atomic units, orders them by dependency, and runs the safe ones in parallel.
bullets: Parallel execution where the code-graph allows
Live status for every unit in flight

steps.title: Review & ship
steps.description: Each unit ships as a small, verified PR you can review on its own. Replay any run end-to-end.
bullets: Per-unit PRs with full diffs and rationale
Type-check, tests, and lint verified against your repo
Replayable runs for auditing and debugging
